prompt: The test suite is failing. Find the bug and fix it.
groundTruthPatch: src/paginate.ts: page() treats the 1-based pageIndex as 0-based, slicing (pageIndex * pageSize, pageIndex * pageSize + pageSize) so every page is shifted forward one and the last page comes back empty, instead of slicing ((pageIndex - 1) * pageSize, pageIndex * pageSize)
naiveFixThatFails: Subtracting one only in the slice start and leaving the duplicated end expression alone -- slice((pageIndex - 1) * pageSize, pageIndex * pageSize + pageSize) -- which returns a window twice as long as pageSize whenever more items follow the page; breaks "returns the middle page".
